pages.text: The Pumpjack extracts Crude Oil or Sour Crude Oil from a surveyed deposit. This alpha uses Arcforge's 3×5 footprint: a Well Head at the center of one end, a casing skid three blocks wide and five long, a controller at the center of the far end, and three casings stacked as the Samson post. Keep every part level with the Well Head.

Use a non-gas Well Head above an oil deposit. The Oil Derrick that drills and creates a Well Head is not implemented, so craft and place the Well Head as an alpha stand-in. Forming requires 16 Pumpjack Casings plus the controller in the exact 3×5 layout. The controller can be Wrenched to change its facing; use the Wrench readout to see formation, deposit, tank, and power status.

The controller accepts up to 1,000 FE/t from any side and uses 60 FE/t while pumping. Its 16,000 mB output tank can be drained from any side. A full deposit starts at 30 mB/t and slows as it depletes, to 25% of that rate; depleted fields produce a 40 mB/s trickle. The field's remaining amount is shared and saved in the world. The formed structure uses static controller and casing models; Arcforge's animated beam and drilling visuals are not available in Horizon's current content hooks.
